name: Certificate Data Set 2
definition: Formal document used to record a fact and used as proof of the fact, in the context of a commercial trade transaction.

CertificateType.name: Certificate Type
CertificateType.definition: Specifies the type of the certificate.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Specifies if the certificate data set is required in relation to specific line items, and which line items.

CertifiedCharacteristics.name: Certified Characteristics
CertifiedCharacteristics.definition: Characteristics of the goods that are certified, in the context of a commercial trade transaction.

PlaceOfIssue.name: Place Of Issue
PlaceOfIssue.definition: Place where the certificate was issued.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Issuer of the certificate, typically the inspection company or its agent.

InspectionDate.name: Inspection Date
InspectionDate.definition: Date(s) at which inspection of the goods took place.

AuthorisedInspectorIndicator.name: Authorised Inspector Indicator
AuthorisedInspectorIndicator.definition: Indicates that the inspection has been performed by an authorised inspector.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.definition: Transport information relative to the goods that are covered by the certificate.

GoodsDescription.name: Goods Description
GoodsDescription.definition: Information about the goods and/or services of a trade transaction.

Consignor.name: Consignor
Consignor.definition: Party responsible for dispatching the goods.

Consignee.name: Consignee
Consignee.definition: Party to whom the goods (which are the subject of the certificate) must be delivered.

Manufacturer.name: Manufacturer
Manufacturer.definition: Manufacturer of the goods which are the subject of the certificate.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional and important information that could not be captured by structured fields.
